description: Get how many more Branch licenses a The Standard Reserve (TSR) charter can still buy today on Robinhood Chain, read live from the License Auction contract (currentDay, purchasedOnDay), compared against the per-charter daily cap. Includes a live quote(n) ladder for buying 1 up to the remaining count (capped at 3), each returning the contract's own unit price and running total. The charter is verified to exist first: an unknown charterId returns a 404, and a burned charter returns a 409 instead of a quote. Requires charterId. Fields ending in _raw are 18-decimal integers as strings.
name: 1s_std_license_headroom
title: TSR License Headroom
